system.description: The ravens impose −3 on all actions, worsened by the tenacity chosen when weaving. A successful Psyche Situation roll (SV 8, modified by power levels) reduces the base penalty to −1 for the current round. Additional tenacity still applies. The normal penalty returns next round.
system.summary: The ravens hinder every action; a successful resistance reduces the penalty for this round.
